inputs.note:
PURPOSE: Score-based conditional retry with deterministic branching

FLOW: Generator → Validator → Condition Node (score >= 0.8?) → [PASS: Success | ELSE: Loop Controller → RETRY or FAIL]

OUTPUT FORMAT: Status (PASS/FAIL) + score + iteration history

data.label: Sticky Note
data.name: stickyNoteAgentflow
data.description: Add notes to the agent flow

inputs.note:
CONDITION LOGIC:
1. score >= 0.8 → PASS (Success Agent)
2. score 0.4-0.79 AND retries < 3 → RETRY (loop back)
3. score < 0.4 OR retries >= 3 → FAIL (Fail Agent)

Loop Node prevents infinite iteration, max 3 retries.

data.label: Retry Controller
data.name: conditionAgentAgentflow
data.description: Route to retry or fail based on score and retry count

inputs.conditionAgentInstructions:
You are the Retry Controller. Analyze the validation results and decide ONE route:

ROUTE 0: RETRY (loop back to Generator)
ROUTE 1: FAIL (terminal, give up)

DECISION LOGIC:
- Check retry_count from Flow State
- Check score from Flow State
- Check max_retries (default: 3)

ROUTING RULES:
→ Route 0 (RETRY) IF:
  - score >= 0.4 (not terrible)
  - AND retry_count < max_retries (attempts remaining)

→ Route 1 (FAIL) IF:
  - score < 0.4 (fundamental issues)
  - OR retry_count >= 3 (max attempts reached)

Return ONLY the route number: 0 or 1

conditionAgentScenarios.scenario: RETRY: Score shows promise (>= 0.4) and retries available (< 3)
FAIL: Score too low (< 0.4) or max retries exceeded (>= 3)
